label: python heredoc: read-only URI connect with uri=True
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('file:/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db?mode=ro',uri=True)
cols=[r[1] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tasks)")]
row=list(c.execute("select * from tasks where id like '%__merge__wf-1%'"))
print(cols, row)
PY

label: python -c read-only connect whose path comes from a shell variable
command:
DB=/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db
echo "=== owner alive? ==="
ps -eo pid,args | grep -iE '[i]nvoker.*(owner|serve)' | head -3 || echo "  none matched"
cat /home/u/.invoker/invoker.db.owner 2>/dev/null | head -2
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('file:$DB?mode=ro',uri=True)
for r in c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table'\"): print('  table:',r[0])
"

label: sqlite3 SELECT-only
command: sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db "SELECT id, status FROM tasks WHERE workflow_id='wf-1'"

label: sqlite3 PRAGMA table_info
command: sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db "PRAGMA table_info(tasks)"

label: sqlite3 sqlite_master read
command: sqlite3 -json ~/.invoker/invoker.db "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='tasks'"

label: sqlite3 dot-command schema read
command: sqlite3 ~/.invoker/invoker.db .schema

label: sqlite3 -readonly reading SQL from a file it cannot write through
command: sqlite3 -readonly ~/.invoker/invoker.db < /tmp/report.sql

label: UPDATE against a database that is not Invoker's
command: sqlite3 /tmp/scratch/copy.db "UPDATE tasks SET status='pending'"

label: a backup file whose name only starts with invoker.db
command: sqlite3 /tmp/scratch/invoker.db.bak "DELETE FROM workflows"

label: cp copying the live file out to a backup
command:
SC=/tmp/scratch
cp -a ~/.invoker/invoker.db "$SC/invoker.db.bak-$(date +%H%M%S)" && echo "  backed up"

label: ls of the database files
command: ls -la ~/.invoker/invoker.db* 2>/dev/null

command:

label: a search for the write pattern
command: rg -n "sqlite3.connect\(.*invoker.db" engine/ | grep -v tests

label: the headless commands themselves
command: invoker-cli retry-task wf-1/build && invoker-cli query tasks --workflow wf-1 --output json

label: python reads Invoker read-only and writes only a scratch database
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
src = sqlite3.connect('file:/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
dst = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/scratch/report.db')
dst.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id TEXT, status TEXT)")
dst.executemany("INSERT INTO t VALUES (?, ?)", src.execute("SELECT id, status FROM tasks"))
dst.commit()
PY

label: python read-only connection setting a connection-level PRAGMA
command: python3 -c "import sqlite3; c=sqlite3.connect('file:/home/u/.invoker/invoker.db?mode=ro', uri=True); c.execute('PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000'); print(c.execute('PRAGMA table_info(tasks)').fetchall())"
